newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Computer Forms can't account for activity.
newsitem.headline: Computer Forms can't account for activity.

text.p: Computer Forms (M) Bhd said on Thursday that it could not account for unusual market activity in its stock.
The printer concern's stock was suspended earlier on Thursday after the company replied to a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) query about its stock activity during market hours.

Computer Forms also said in a statement to the KLSE that it was not aware of any rumours or other conditions to explain its share activity, adding that there were no material developments in its business "that have not been previously disclosed".
Its stock last traded down 50 cents to 18.10 ringgit prior to the suspension.
